svg.title: Pelican riding a bicycle
svg.desc: Animated SVG (SMIL). A pelican rides a bicycle along a coastal road: wheels spin, chain and cranks turn, legs pedal with exact inverse kinematics, body and neck bob, wing rests on the handlebar, pouch jiggles, scarf flutters, scenery scrolls with parallax.
